```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7, dpi = 150
)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(patchwork)
  library(cowplot)
  library(scales)
  library(gt)
  library(DT)
  library(data.table)
  library(tidyverse)
})

split_param <- function(x) strsplit(x, ",")[[1]]

eqtl_universe_file    <- params$eqtl_universe
classification_file   <- params$classification
heterogeneity_file    <- params$heterogeneity_test
ocr_enrich_file       <- params$ocr_enrich
glm_enrich_file       <- params$glm_enrich
eqtl_effects_file     <- params$eqtl_effects
effect_repl_file      <- params$eqtl_effect_replication
fetal_l1_order        <- split_param(params$fetal_l1)   # fetal_l1_types
jang_l1_order         <- split_param(params$jang_l1)    # jang_l1_order

benchmark_pairs <- split_param(params$benchmarks)
benchmark_files <- tibble(rule = sub("=.*", "", benchmark_pairs),
                          file = sub("^[^=]*=", "", benchmark_pairs))

gene_lookup <- read_tsv(params$gene_lookup, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(ensembl_gene_id, external_gene_name) |>
  distinct(ensembl_gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Smaller-font DT wrapper for wide tables (Heterogeneity results,
# Subcluster-specific gene table) so all columns fit on screen
small_dt <- function(df, page_length = 20) {
  datatable(
    df, filter = "top", rownames = FALSE, class = "compact stripe hover",
    options = list(
      pageLength = page_length, scrollX = TRUE,
      initComplete = DT::JS(
        "function(settings, json) {",
        "$(this.api().table().container()).css({'font-size': '75%'});",
        "}"
      )
    )
  )
}
```

```{r load-data}
eqtl_universe    <- read_rds(eqtl_universe_file)
classification   <- read_rds(classification_file)
het_test         <- read_rds(heterogeneity_file)
ocr_enrich       <- read_rds(ocr_enrich_file)
glm_enrich       <- read_rds(glm_enrich_file)
eqtl_effects     <- read_rds(eqtl_effects_file)
effect_repl      <- read_rds(effect_repl_file)

# Unpack classification
any_table    <- classification$any_table
any_summary  <- classification$any_summary

# Collapse the untestable categories into one "untestable" display bucket
# (display only; the classification output keeps them separate):
#   - untestable_genotyped_not_expressed / untestable_not_genotyped_not_expressed
#   - testable_pair_untested (gene and SNP each present in Jang, but never tested
#     together in one Jang cell type)
any_summary <- any_summary |>
  mutate(final_category = recode(final_category,
    untestable_genotyped_not_expressed     = "untestable",
    untestable_not_genotyped_not_expressed = "untestable",
    testable_pair_untested                 = "untestable"
  )) |>
  group_by(final_category) |>
  summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(prop = round(n / sum(n), 3))

any_table <- any_table |>
  mutate(final_category = recode(final_category,
    untestable_genotyped_not_expressed     = "untestable",
    untestable_not_genotyped_not_expressed = "untestable",
    testable_pair_untested                 = "untestable"
  ))

# Unpack heterogeneity test (Cochran's Q on fetal-specific pairs). het_usable
# is the detail level (one row per fetal-adult comparison); het_heterogeneous
# is the aggregated, stringent pair-level call (heterogeneous in ALL tested
# adult comparisons).
het_usable        <- het_test$usable
het_heterogeneous <- het_test$heterogeneous_pairs
# Funnel stage labels: drop old step prefixes ("B: ", "C: ") for display
het_funnel        <- het_test$funnel |>
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ sub("^[A-Z]: ", "", .x)))

# Magnitude consistency (computed in eqtl_sharing_heterogeneity.R)
het_magnitude_consistent   <- het_test$magnitude_consistent_pairs
het_magnitude_inconsistent <- het_test$magnitude_inconsistent_pairs
het_stringent_magnitude    <- het_test$stringent_magnitude

# Unpack subcluster/supercluster effect-size object
subcluster_tbl   <- eqtl_effects$subcluster_specific
supercluster_tbl <- eqtl_effects$supercluster_specific

# Effect sizes: wide fetal L1 x Jang L1 matrix and long table
effect_matrix <- eqtl_effects$effect_size_matrix
effect_long   <- eqtl_effects$effect_size_long

# Display order for the effect-size tables: fetal L1, then Jang L1
full_order <- c(fetal_l1_order, paste0("Jang_", jang_l1_order))
full_order <- full_order[paste0("slope_", full_order) %in% names(effect_matrix)]
```

## Developmental specificity pipeline steps {.tabset}

***

1. `extract_eqtl_universe`: Extract unique fetal eGene-eSNP universe (L1+L2)
2. `classify_eqtl_specificity`: Classify pairs as testable/untestable and shared/fetal-specific vs Jang et al. 2026 ("any" tier, all L1+L2 Jang types pooled)
3. `heterogeneity_test`: Cochran's Q test on fetal-specific pairs vs all tested adult Jang cell types
4. `prep_ld_clump_input` / `run_ld_clump` / `parse_ld_clump`: LD-independence pruning of the eGene-eSNP universe
5. `ocr_enrich`: Test fetal-specific/shared/specific-heterogeneous eQTL enrichment in adult (Li et al.) cortical union OCRs
6. `glm_enrich`: Compare adult OCR overlap of fetal-specific vs shared eQTL (logistic regression)
7. `eqtl_effect_sizes`: Effect sizes across fetal and Jang L1 cell types; subcluster/supercluster-specific eQTL (Supp Table 3)
8. `eqtl_effect_replication`: Discovery -> replication effect-size correlations (Supp Figs 7-8)
9. `eqtl_sharing_report`: Generate this report

Fetal-adult pi1 and effect-size concordance with matched Jang cell types are in the
06 replication report.

***

### Classification of fetal eQTL {.tabset}

Classify fetal eQTL against Jang et al. 2026 (SingleBrain) adult eGene-eSNP pairs, 
pooled across all L1+L2 Jang cell types (35 types; MiGA3 excluded -- 
a separate microglia-only meta-analysis, not part of the core L1+L2 hierarchy).

- `testable_shared`: fetal SNP's own Random_P (Jang nom. file) clears a Bonferroni threshold (0.05 / 35 cell types / n testable pairs) in >= 1 Jang cell type
  - Feeds: OCR enrichment (as the "shared" SNP set)
- `testable_specific`: present in Jang nom file, but Random_P doesn't clear that threshold in any cell type
  - Feeds: Heterogeneity test (next section), OCR enrichment (as the "fetal-specific" SNP set)
- `untestable_*_not_expressed`: gene not expressed in Jang at all -- combined into a 4th OCR SNP set (see OCR section)

Significance is checked on the fetal SNP's own Jang p-value directly, not gated on
being Jang's independently-chosen lead SNP (tracked separately, informational only).

Both testable categories are LD-pruned (see LD-clumping steps) before being used in OCR enrichment.

Beta/SE in Jang derived from fixed_beta/fixed_SD; significance from Random_P.

***

### Heterogeneity test (fetal-specific eQTL) {.tabset}

- Cochran's Q: Tests whether the fetal and adult effect sizes differ by more
than combined sampling error predicts
- Each `testable_specific` pair is collapsed to a single fetal reference row
(whichever fetal cell type it's most significant in), then tested against
EVERY adult Jang cell type that pair was actually tested in 
- FDR (BH) applied once, pooled across all usable rows
- STRINGENT final call: a pair only counts as fetal-specific-and-heterogeneous
if heterogeneous in ALL of its tested adult comparisons, not just one
- **Allele harmonization**: No AF column in Jang, so
palindromic (A/T, C/G) SNPs cannot be disambiguated via frequency the way
they could with allele frequencies. Every palindromic pair is therefore uniformly `palindromic_unresolved` and excluded from the Q-test.
- Notes:
  - Q is not directional -- it tells you the betas differ, not which way
  - Pairs tested against more adult cell types face a harder bar under the
    "all" rule -- see the stringency table below
  - A pair only feeds OCR enrichment's "specific_heterogeneous" SNP set if it
    is ALSO magnitude-consistent (|fetal beta| > |adult beta| in every tested
    comparison) -- see the Magnitude-consistent/-inconsistent tabs below

***

#### Summary

```{r het-test-funnel}
het_funnel |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Population funnel")
```

```{r het-test-summary-stats, results = "asis"}
n_row_het    <- sum(het_usable$heterogeneous)
n_row_total  <- nrow(het_usable)
n_pair_het   <- sum(het_heterogeneous$heterogeneous_all)
n_pair_total <- nrow(het_heterogeneous)

cat(sprintf(
  paste0(
    "At the individual fetal-adult comparison level, %d of %d tested comparisons (%s) ",
    "were formally heterogeneous (FDR < 0.05). Applying the stringent rule -- heterogeneous ",
    "in **all** tested adult comparisons -- %d of %d testable_specific pairs (%s) pass."
  ),
  n_row_het, n_row_total, percent(n_row_het / n_row_total, accuracy = 0.1),
  n_pair_het, n_pair_total, percent(n_pair_het / n_pair_total, accuracy = 0.1)
))
```

```{r het-test-stringency-effect}
het_heterogeneous |>
  mutate(n_bucket = if_else(n_comparisons_tested >= 4, "4+", as.character(n_comparisons_tested))) |>
  group_by(n_bucket) |>
  summarise(N_Pairs = n(), N_Passed_All = sum(heterogeneous_all), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(Pass_Rate = percent(N_Passed_All / N_Pairs, accuracy = 0.1)) |>
  arrange(n_bucket) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Pass rate by number of adult comparisons tested",
             subtitle = "Pairs tested against more adult cell types face a harder bar under the 'all' rule")
```

***

#### Magnitude-consistent pairs (|fetal| > |adult|)

Restricts the `r n_pair_het` stringent (heterogeneous-in-all) pairs further: retains
only those where |fetal beta| > |adult beta| in EVERY tested comparison for
that pair -- not just heterogeneous, but the fetal effect strictly larger in
magnitude, regardless of sign. This sidesteps delta_beta's ambiguity when
fetal and adult betas have opposite signs (delta_beta can look "fetal-bigger"
even when adult's magnitude is actually larger). Feeds OCR enrichment's
"specific_heterogeneous" SNP set (see OCR section) -- computed in
eqtl_sharing_heterogeneity.R, not re-derived here.

```{r het-test-magnitude-prep}
stringent_magnitude <- het_stringent_magnitude

pair_magnitude <- het_heterogeneous |>
  filter(heterogeneous_all) |>
  transmute(phenotype_id, variant_id, fetal_cell_type,
            n_comparisons = n_comparisons_tested,
            magnitude_consistent, min_magnitude_diff, max_magnitude_diff)
```

```{r het-test-magnitude-summary-stats, results = "asis"}
n_pass <- sum(pair_magnitude$magnitude_consistent)
n_total <- nrow(pair_magnitude)

cat(sprintf(
  "%d of %d stringent pairs (%s) also have |fetal beta| > |adult beta| in EVERY tested comparison.",
  n_pass, n_total, percent(n_pass / n_total, accuracy = 0.1)
))
```

```{r het-test-magnitude-summary-table}
pair_magnitude |>
  count(magnitude_consistent, name = "N_Pairs") |>
  mutate(Proportion = percent(N_Pairs / sum(N_Pairs), accuracy = 0.1)) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Magnitude consistency (|fetal beta| > |adult beta|) across a pair's comparisons")
```

```{r het-test-magnitude-histogram, fig.height=4, fig.width=7}
ggplot(stringent_magnitude, aes(x = magnitude_diff)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#4DAF4A", colour = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
  labs(x = "|fetal beta| - |adult beta| (per comparison)", y = "N comparisons") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
```

```{r het-test-magnitude-final-table}
het_magnitude_consistent |>
  select(ENSG = phenotype_id, Symbol = gene_symbol, eSNP = variant_id,
         Fetal_Cell_Type = fetal_cell_type, N_Comparisons = n_comparisons_tested,
         Min_Magnitude_Diff = min_magnitude_diff, Max_Magnitude_Diff = max_magnitude_diff) |>
  arrange(Min_Magnitude_Diff) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4))) |>
  small_dt()
```

#### Adult-larger comparisons

```{r het-test-adult-bigger-prep}
adult_bigger_rows <- stringent_magnitude |>
  filter(magnitude_diff < 0) |>
  arrange(magnitude_diff)

target_pairs <- adult_bigger_rows |>
  distinct(phenotype_id, variant_id, cell_type)

target_rows <- stringent_magnitude |>
  semi_join(target_pairs, by = c("phenotype_id", "variant_id", "cell_type"))

side_by_side <- target_rows |>
  left_join(gene_lookup, by = c("phenotype_id" = "ensembl_gene_id")) |>
  select(phenotype_id, external_gene_name, variant_id, cell_type,
         beta_my, jang_cell_type, beta_jang_harmonized, magnitude_diff) |>
  group_by(phenotype_id, variant_id, cell_type) |>
  mutate(Fetal_Beta = first(beta_my)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-beta_my) |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(phenotype_id, external_gene_name, variant_id, cell_type, Fetal_Beta),
    names_from = jang_cell_type,
    values_from = c(beta_jang_harmonized, magnitude_diff),
    names_glue = "{jang_cell_type}_{.value}"
  ) |>
  rename(Gene = external_gene_name, ENSG = phenotype_id, eSNP = variant_id,
         Fetal_Cell_Type = cell_type)

mixed_flag <- target_rows |>
  distinct(phenotype_id, variant_id) |>
  left_join(
    stringent_magnitude |>
      group_by(phenotype_id, variant_id) |>
      summarise(all_adult_bigger = all(!fetal_bigger), .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("phenotype_id", "variant_id")
  ) |>
  mutate(pair_type = if_else(all_adult_bigger, "adult_bigger_everywhere",
                              "mixed -- fetal bigger in >=1 other comparison"))
```

```{r het-test-adult-bigger-summary-stats, results = "asis"}
cat(sprintf(
  "%d individual comparisons (across %d unique gene/SNP/fetal-cell-type triples) show |adult beta| > |fetal beta|.",
  nrow(adult_bigger_rows), nrow(target_pairs)
))
```

```{r het-test-adult-bigger-breakdown}
mixed_flag |>
  count(pair_type, name = "N_Triples") |>
  mutate(Proportion = percent(N_Triples / sum(N_Triples), accuracy = 0.1)) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Breakdown: adult-bigger-everywhere vs mixed")
```

```{r het-test-adult-bigger-table}

```

### Effect sizes {.tabset}

***

#### Full slope table

Betas for every (eGene, eSNP) pair across the 7 fetal L1 cell types and 7
Jang adult L1-pooled cell types. Rows with no gene symbol show
"(no symbol)" in the Symbol column -- type that into the column's search
box (top of the table) to filter to just those rows.

```{r full-slope-table}
slope_full_tbl <- effect_matrix |>
  left_join(gene_lookup, by = c("phenotype_id" = "ensembl_gene_id")) |>
  select(external_gene_name, phenotype_id, variant_id,
         all_of(paste0("slope_", full_order))) |>
  rename(Symbol = external_gene_name, ENSG_ID = phenotype_id, SNP = variant_id) |>
  mutate(Symbol = if_else(is.na(Symbol) | Symbol == "", "(no symbol)", Symbol)) |>
  rename_with(~ str_remove(., "^slope_"), starts_with("slope_"))

small_dt(slope_full_tbl)
```

***

### Effect replication {.tabset}

For each fetal discovery cell type, its sig. lead eGene-eSNP pairs
(qval < `r effect_repl$settings$fdr_thresh`) are looked up in every replication
cell type with no significance cutoff there; Pearson r of the two slopes.
Rows are discovery, columns replication, so A -> B can differ from B -> A.
Same layout as Supp Figs 7-8 (manuscript_figure_effect_size_heatmaps.R), without
the Glu-A/Glu-B relabelling.

```{r effect-repl-setup}
mat_to_long <- function(mat) {
  as_tibble(mat, rownames = "discovery") |>
    pivot_longer(-discovery, names_to = "replication", values_to = "r")
}

plot_corr_heatmap <- function(df, x_lab, y_lab, cell_text_size, axis_text_size,
                              base_size = 13) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = replication, y = discovery, fill = r)) +
    geom_tile(color = "black", lwd = 1.1, linetype = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(r), "NA", sprintf("%.2f", r))),
              color = "black", size = cell_text_size) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"),
      limits = c(-1, 1),
      na.value = "grey80",
      name = "Pearson r"
    ) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(x = x_lab, y = y_lab) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold", size = axis_text_size),
      axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = axis_text_size),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
}

# Fetal order: each L1 type followed by its subclusters, as in Supp Fig 7
fetal_cts <- effect_repl$settings$fetal_cell_types
fetal_family_order <- unlist(lapply(fetal_l1_order, function(l1)
  c(l1, sort(fetal_cts[startsWith(fetal_cts, paste0(l1, "-"))]))))
fetal_family_order <- fetal_family_order[fetal_family_order %in% fetal_cts]
```

```{r effect-repl-fetal, fig.height=12, fig.width=12}
plot_corr_heatmap(fetal_repl_long,
```

***

### Gene symbol coverage {.tabset}

Investigates why the final magnitude-consistent set (see Heterogeneity test
above) has 100% gene-symbol coverage -- tracks Ensembl ID / gene-symbol
coverage through each stage of the pipeline, from the full fetal eGene
universe down to the final magnitude-consistent set.

**Caveat**: `final_category` is assigned per (gene, SNP) PAIR, not per gene --
a gene with multiple SNPs can appear under more than one category (e.g. one
SNP `testable_specific`, another `testable_shared` for the same gene). The
"By classification category" tab below allows that overlap openly (a gene may
be counted in more than one row) rather than forcing each gene into a single
bucket.

***

#### Funnel

The sequential path that actually produced the final magnitude-consistent
set: full universe -> `testable_specific` -> usable (post allele
harmonization) -> stringent (heterogeneous in all comparisons) ->
magnitude-consistent.

```{r symbol-funnel-prep}
check_symbol_coverage <- function(gene_ids, gene_lookup, stage_label) {
  gene_ids <- unique(gene_ids)
  matched <- gene_lookup$external_gene_name[match(gene_ids, gene_lookup$ensembl_gene_id)]
  has_symbol <- !is.na(matched) & matched != ""
  tibble(
    Stage = stage_label,
    N_Unique_Genes = length(gene_ids),
    N_With_Symbol = sum(has_symbol),
    N_Without_Symbol = length(gene_ids) - sum(has_symbol)
  )
}

symbol_funnel <- bind_rows(
  check_symbol_coverage(eqtl_universe$phenotype_id, gene_lookup,
                         "Full fetal eGene universe"),
  check_symbol_coverage(any_table |> filter(final_category == "testable_specific") |> pull(phenotype_id),
                         gene_lookup, "testable_specific pairs"),
  check_symbol_coverage(het_usable$phenotype_id, gene_lookup,
                         "Usable rows (post allele harmonization)"),
  check_symbol_coverage(het_heterogeneous |> filter(heterogeneous_all) |> pull(phenotype_id),
                         gene_lookup, "Heterogeneous in ALL comparisons (stringent)"),
  check_symbol_coverage(het_magnitude_consistent$phenotype_id, gene_lookup,
                         "Magnitude-consistent (final)")
) |>
  mutate(Pct_With_Symbol = percent(N_With_Symbol / N_Unique_Genes, accuracy = 0.1))
```

```{r symbol-funnel-table}
symbol_funnel |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Gene symbol coverage through the fetal-specific/heterogeneous pipeline")
```

***

#### By classification category

Cross-sectional view across ALL of `any_table`'s categories (not just the
funnel path taken) -- tests whether symbol coverage differs systematically
between testable and untestable/not-expressed categories, which would point
to the bias being baked in at the classification step itself (most plausibly
via Jang's own gene detection skewing toward well-annotated genes) rather
than introduced anywhere downstream in this pipeline.

```{r symbol-by-category-prep}
symbol_by_category <- any_table |>
  distinct(phenotype_id, final_category) |>
  left_join(gene_lookup, by = c("phenotype_id" = "ensembl_gene_id")) |>
  mutate(has_symbol = !is.na(external_gene_name) & external_gene_name != "") |>
  group_by(final_category) |>
  summarise(
    N_Unique_Genes = n(),
    N_With_Symbol = sum(has_symbol),
    N_Without_Symbol = n() - sum(has_symbol),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(Pct_With_Symbol = percent(N_With_Symbol / N_Unique_Genes, accuracy = 0.1)) |>
  arrange(desc(N_Unique_Genes))
```

```{r symbol-by-category-table}
symbol_by_category |>
  rename(Final_Category = final_category) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Gene symbol coverage by classification category")
```

```{r symbol-by-category-plot, fig.height=4, fig.width=7}
symbol_by_category |>
  mutate(prop_with_symbol = N_With_Symbol / N_Unique_Genes,
         final_category = fct_reorder(final_category, prop_with_symbol)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = final_category, y = prop_with_symbol)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#377EB8") +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent(prop_with_symbol, accuracy = 0.1)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion of unique genes with a gene symbol") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
```

### GLM: fetal-specific vs shared {.tabset}

- Logistic regression of overlap with Li et al. 2023 adult cortical cCREs (union)
on SNP set (fetal-specific = 1, shared = 0), LD-independent SNPs only, no covariates
- Hypothesis: fetal-specific eQTL overlap adult OCRs less than shared eQTL
(odds ratio < 1); the one-tailed P tests this direction
- Unlike the OCR enrichment, there is no genomic background model: the two
sets are compared with each other

#### Sibling comparison table

```{r subcluster-sibling-table-prep}
family_order <- list(
  "Glu-UL" = c("Glu-UL", "Glu-UL-0", "Glu-UL-1", "Glu-UL-2"),
  "Glu-DL" = c("Glu-DL", "Glu-DL-0", "Glu-DL-1", "Glu-DL-2"),
  "GABA"   = c("GABA", "GABA-0", "GABA-1", "GABA-2"),
  "NPC"    = c("NPC", "NPC-0", "NPC-1", "NPC-2")
)

build_sibling_table <- function(subcluster_tbl, effect_long, gene_lookup) {

  fam_lookup <- bind_rows(lapply(names(family_order), function(f) {
    tibble(parent_L1 = f, cell_type_L2 = family_order[[f]][-1])
  }))

  base <- subcluster_tbl |>
    select(phenotype_id, variant_id, gene_symbol, parent_L1,
           sig_cell_type = cell_type_L2,
           Slope_Sig = slope_L2, SE_Sig = se_L2, Pval_Sig = pval_nom_L2,
           Slope_L1 = slope_parent, SE_L1 = se_parent, Pval_L1 = pval_nom_parent)

  sibling_map <- fam_lookup |>
    inner_join(base |> distinct(phenotype_id, variant_id, parent_L1, sig_cell_type),
               by = "parent_L1", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
    filter(cell_type_L2 != sig_cell_type) |>
    group_by(phenotype_id, variant_id) |>
    mutate(sib_slot = paste0("Sib", row_number())) |>
    ungroup()

  sib_stats <- sibling_map |>
    left_join(
      effect_long |> select(phenotype_id, variant_id, cell_type,
                             Slope = slope, SE = slope_se, Pval = pval_nominal),
      by = c("phenotype_id", "variant_id", "cell_type_L2" = "cell_type")
    )

  sib_wide <- sib_stats |>
    select(phenotype_id, variant_id, sib_slot, cell_type_L2, Slope, SE, Pval) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = sib_slot,
      values_from = c(cell_type_L2, Slope, SE, Pval),
      names_glue = "{sib_slot}_{.value}"
    )

  base |>
    left_join(gene_lookup, by = c("phenotype_id" = "ensembl_gene_id")) |>
    left_join(sib_wide, by = c("phenotype_id", "variant_id"))
}

sibling_tbl <- build_sibling_table(subcluster_tbl, effect_long, gene_lookup)
```

```{r subcluster-sibling-table}
sibling_tbl |>
  select(
    Gene = external_gene_name, ENSG = phenotype_id, eSNP = variant_id,
    cell_type_L2a = sig_cell_type, Slope_L2a = Slope_Sig, SE_L2a = SE_Sig, Pval_L2a = Pval_Sig,
    cell_type_L1 = parent_L1, Slope_L1, SE_L1, Pval_L1,
    cell_type_L2b = Sib1_cell_type_L2, Slope_L2b = Sib1_Slope, SE_L2b = Sib1_SE, Pval_L2b = Sib1_Pval,
    cell_type_L2c = Sib2_cell_type_L2, Slope_L2c = Sib2_Slope, SE_L2c = Sib2_SE, Pval_L2c = Sib2_Pval
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))) |>
  small_dt()
```

#### Family heatmaps {.tabset}

For each L1 family with L2 subtypes, betas across the parent and its 3
children for every subcluster-specific (gene, SNP) pair in that family.
Black border marks the cell where the pair was actually classified
subcluster-specific.

```{r subcluster-family-heatmap-prep}
build_family_matrix <- function(family, subcluster_tbl, effect_long, gene_lookup) {
  members <- family_order[[family]]

  fam_pairs <- subcluster_tbl |>
    filter(parent_L1 == family) |>
    distinct(phenotype_id, variant_id, cell_type_L2) |>
    left_join(gene_lookup, by = c("phenotype_id" = "ensembl_gene_id")) |>
    mutate(pair_label = paste0(coalesce(external_gene_name, phenotype_id), " (", variant_id, ")"))

  if (nrow(fam_pairs) == 0) return(NULL)

  slopes <- effect_long |>
    filter(cell_type %in% members,
           phenotype_id %in% fam_pairs$phenotype_id,
           variant_id %in% fam_pairs$variant_id) |>
    inner_join(fam_pairs |> select(phenotype_id, variant_id, pair_label),
               by = c("phenotype_id", "variant_id"))

  slope_wide <- slopes |>
    select(pair_label, cell_type, slope) |>
    distinct(pair_label, cell_type, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = cell_type, values_from = slope)

  for (m in members) if (!(m %in% names(slope_wide))) slope_wide[[m]] <- NA_real_

  mat <- as.matrix(slope_wide[, members])
  rownames(mat) <- slope_wide$pair_label

  sig_mat <- matrix(FALSE, nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = ncol(mat), dimnames = dimnames(mat))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(fam_pairs))) {
    pl <- fam_pairs$pair_label[i]
    sig_ct <- fam_pairs$cell_type_L2[i]
    if (pl %in% rownames(sig_mat) && sig_ct %in% colnames(sig_mat)) {
      sig_mat[pl, sig_ct] <- TRUE
    }
  }

  list(mat = mat, sig_mat = sig_mat)
}

col_fun_family <- colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))

draw_family_heatmap <- function(family, row_height_in = NULL) {
  fam_data <- build_family_matrix(family, subcluster_tbl, effect_long, gene_lookup)
  if (is.null(fam_data)) {
    cat("No subcluster-specific genes for", family, ".\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  ht_args <- list(
    matrix = fam_data$mat,
    name = "Slope",
    col = col_fun_family,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    na_col = "grey90",
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
      if (fam_data$sig_mat[i, j]) {
        grid.rect(x, y, width, height, gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 2, fill = NA))
      }
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(row_height_in)) {
    ht_args$height <- unit(row_height_in, "in") * nrow(fam_data$mat)
  }

  do.call(Heatmap, ht_args)

}
```

### Benchmarking {.tabset}

***

#### Table

```{r benchmarking, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Benchmark files of the current rules are passed by the rule as rule=path
# pairs; files not yet written (rules not run) are skipped
benchmarks <- benchmark_files |>
  filter(file.exists(file)) |>
  pmap_dfr(function(rule, file) {
    df <- read.table(file, header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
    tibble(
      file = file,
      rule = rule,
      runtime_sec = df$s,
      runtime_hms = df$h.m.s.,
      max_rss = df$max_rss
    )
  })

summary <- benchmarks |>
  group_by(rule) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_runtime_min = mean(runtime_sec) / 60,
    sd_runtime_min = sd(runtime_sec) / 60,
    mean_ram_gb = mean(max_rss) / 1024,
    sd_ram_gb = sd(max_rss) / 1024,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    sd_runtime_min = if_else(is.na(sd_runtime_min), 0, sd_runtime_min),
    sd_ram_gb = if_else(is.na(sd_ram_gb), 0, sd_ram_gb)
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) |>
  arrange(rule)

summary |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Benchmarking",
    subtitle = "Means and SD across replicates"
  ) |>
  cols_label(
    rule = "Rule",
    n = "N",
    mean_runtime_min = "Mean Runtime (min)",
    sd_runtime_min = "SD Runtime (min)",
    mean_ram_gb = "Mean RAM (GB)",
    sd_ram_gb = "SD RAM (GB)"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(mean_runtime_min, sd_runtime_min, mean_ram_gb, sd_ram_gb),
    decimals = 2
  ) |>
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(14),
    table.border.top.style = "none",
    table.border.bottom.style = "solid",
    table.border.bottom.width = px(2),
    table.border.bottom.color = "black",
    heading.align = "center"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  )
```
